# Hüseyin DOL (huseyindol)

> Senior Frontend Developer with 10+ years of experience building modern, scalable web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Also experienced in Java Spring Boot backend, Kubernetes DevOps, and React Native mobile.

Hüseyin DOL specializes in scalable, performant, and user-friendly full-stack architectures. He has hands-on experience in team leadership and mentoring junior developers.
